description: Approximate, reference-led exterior blockout of the legacy Gram GIF 400 continuous ice-cream freezer.
dimensionBasis: The exact GIF 400 listing from ISF Industries publishes a 1450 x 600 x 1600 mm envelope, 700 kg weight, and 11 kW power rating. The model uses those exterior bounds.

references.use: GIF-series construction, self-contained layout, integrated HMI, controls, utility connections, and current family silhouette.
Legacy GIF-series cabinet construction and compact chassis dimensions documented for GIF 600/1200.
Exact GIF 400 label and exterior silhouette: cabinet, HMI, pump housings, flange, front pipework, and adjustable feet.
references.note: The pictured units are built by ISF Industries and marked Made in India. Treat the image as an installed/licensed-variant reference rather than proof of the Gram factory revision.

references.use: Exact GIF 400 identification, cabinet proportions, control column placement, front process hardware, and tapered leveling legs.
Gram control-panel layout, side access panels, front flange, sanitary pipework, and cabinet proportions on the adjacent GIF 600 model.
Exact GIF 400 identification and published 1450 x 600 x 1600 mm dimensions, 700 kg weight, and 11 kW power listing.

recognizableFeatures: Tall, narrow stainless cabinet with a deeper refrigeration chassis.
Front-mounted HMI in the upper control area.
Upper and lower cylindrical sanitary pump or valve housings.
Large central circular process flange linked to the upper housing by exposed pipework.
Adjustable feet, front service seams, compact controls, and emergency stop.

confidence.note: The exact GIF 400 equipment listing states 1450 x 600 x 1600 mm. Installed utility fittings and factory revisions may change local extents.
The total envelope is published for GIF 400. Cabinet-to-fitting proportions are estimated from the exact listing and licensed-variant photographs.
Locations and relative sizes follow the GIF 400 product image and used GIF 600 photographs. Pipe routes are simplified for floor-view readability.

confidence.area: Rear, internal refrigeration system, and installed factory revision
confidence.note: No on-site GIF 400 photographs or internal drawings were available. Hidden mechanisms are represented only by the cabinet volume.

usage.purpose: QC floor visualization and freezer selection
usage.notes: This is a schematic visual asset, not a fabrication, installation, maintenance, process-piping, or safety model.
